correctness.rationale: A fall coloring of C_n² n>=7 must use 3,4 or 5 colors. For 3 colors, proper cyclic triples force period 3, so exactly one partition iff 3|n. For 5 colors all cyclic five-windows are rainbow and period 5, so exactly one iff 5|n. For four colors, a 48-state quadruple automaton with transitions validating proper triples and every cyclic 5-window using four letters gives F_n=tr(T^n) labeled colorings, and F_n/24 unlabeled partitions. Independent Newton identities from tr(T^1..T^48) establish exactly the stated factored D(t)=det(I-tT), hence -tD'/D for all n. Direct cyclic enumeration n=7..15 matches counts (0,7,3,5,0,31,13,35,20); n=7,11 impossible. Every genuine four-color fall word has a four-distinct consecutive block; duplication increases n by 4 preserving admissibility, and length witnesses 8,9,10,15 imply existence for all n>=8 except 11. This proves all-n spectrum rather than extrapolating small checks.
